title: First hypnotic regression: tall being working on him
place_text: aboard craft near November 5, South Dakota

tellings.quote: Pleasant and these these were the the one that was messing with me was a very tall one

plain: Mario Woods, a former guard at a nuclear weapons site, says that in 1977 in South Dakota he was taken aboard a craft. He tells podcast host Jesse Michels that during his first hypnotic regression, a session where a hypnotist helps someone recall buried memories, done with a man named Bob Upton, he remembered a very tall being working on him. If true, it would mean beings were abducting the people guarding America's nuclear weapons.
